{{Quote|Now what are you up to?»<br />«Oh, just humming a lullaby my mama would sing to my sister and me.|translated=1|Urgah and Kneesaa a Jari Kintaka|<ref name="Rampage of the Phlogs">{{Ewoks|Rampage of the Phlogs}}</ref>}}
The [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] [[Ra-Lee/Legends|Ra-Lee]] sang a '''lullaby''' to her daughters, [[Kneesaa a Jari Kintaka/Legends|Kneesaa a Jari Kintaka]] and [[Asha/Legends|Asha]], when the girls were still young [[Wokling/Legends|woklings]]. Years later, in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], Kintaka still remembered the song. That year, she was kidnapped by a [[Gorneesh's tribe|tribe]] of [[Dulok/Legends|Duloks]] and forced to babysit a [[Phlog/Legends|Phlog]] infant named [[Nahkee]] at the [[Dulok Swamp]] along with friends from her [[Bright Tree Village tribe|tribe]]&mdash;[[Wicket Wystri Warrick/Legends|Wicket W. Warrick]], [[Teebo/Legends|Teebo]], [[Malani]], and [[Latara/Legends|Latara]]. Latara formulated a plan to use the lullaby to escape. The scheme began wihen Kintaka began humming the tune. The Dulok [[Queen/Legends|Queen]], [[Urgah]], heard the performance and sarcastically demanded that Kintaka serenade the entire village. Kintaka complied, accompanied by Latara on her [[Flute/Legends|flute]]. Meanwhile, Teebo secured the aid of several [[Bird/Legends|birds]] known as [[humming peeper]]s. In conjunction with the birds' fast-beating wings, Kintaka's tune lulled the Duloks to sleep. With their captors dozing, the Ewoks escaped with the baby Phlog.
